event.title: Compute no-lookahead 5s/30s per-fill markouts on copied market data
event.summary: Offline per-day and per-instrument fill alignment with fresh order books strictly older than each sampling time, explicit gap invalidation, duplicate detection and real-vs-synthetic separation.

changes.summary: Event-stream aligned 5s and 30s markouts on broker fills without look-ahead.
Synthetic market gap, stale future book, equal-time and no-overwrite tests.
Usage and limitations: markout is not P&L or execution model.

next_actions.title: After validated tests, add optional mapping-aware coordinator support

limitations: No real fills or private accounts used in tests.
No live trading, calibration or code changes outside Analytics.
